_comment: Analog Atlas - physical constants per body. Owner: Michal (task M2), drafted by Eduard so the engine and the site cards have values to run with. Michal: verify every number and add a citation in the README. These drive the always-on 'where it breaks' lines on every site card, so they are judged content, not decoration.

earth.name: Earth
earth.radiation_note: Shielded by the magnetosphere and ~1000 g/cm2 of atmosphere.
earth.regolith_note: Weathered, hydrated, biologically altered; grains rounded by water and wind.

moon.name: Moon
moon.magnetic_field: none global; local crustal swirls only
moon.radiation_note: Unshielded GCR and solar particle events; no magnetosphere, no atmosphere.
moon.regolith_note: Sharp, unweathered, agglutinate-rich, space-weathered, electrostatically charged.

mars.name: Mars
mars.magnetic_field: no global field; crustal remanent magnetism in the southern highlands
mars.radiation_note: No global field and ~16 g/cm2 of CO2; surface dose roughly 0.2-0.3 mSv/day.
mars.regolith_note: Oxidized basaltic dust, perchlorate salts, fine and strongly electrostatic.

gravity_scaled_baselines_m._comment: Earth roughness baselines that correspond to the 2 km and 10 km planetary baselines under 1/g landform scaling. Heuristic - say so on the site card.
